CVE-2026-118371.title: LibreSSL through 4.4.0 contains a CRLF injection vulnerability in ...
CVE-2026-118371.description: LibreSSL through 4.4.0 contains a CRLF injection vulnerability in the libcrypto OCSP_sendreq_new() and OCSP_parse_url() functions, which write unvalidated request paths into the OCSP POST request line. Attackers can embed carriage return and line feed characters in a certificate's Authority Information Access OCSP URI to inject HTTP headers or split requests sent to responders and proxies.

CVE-2026-118372.title: LibreSSL ocspcheck through 4.4.0 contains a CRLF injection vulner ...
CVE-2026-118372.description: LibreSSL ocspcheck through 4.4.0 contains a CRLF injection vulnerability that allows attackers to inject HTTP headers by embedding CR/LF sequences in a certificate's AIA OCSP URI path. Because url2host() copies the path without rejecting control characters and http_open() places it in the POST request line, attackers can inject headers or split OCSP requests sent to the responder host.

CVE-2026-118373.title: LibreSSL ocspcheck through 4.4.0 contains a cleartext transmissio ...
CVE-2026-118373.description: LibreSSL ocspcheck through 4.4.0 contains a cleartext transmission vulnerability because url2host() discards the OCSP URL scheme and http_alloc() only selects TLS for port 443. On-path network attackers can read OCSP requests sent to https responder URLs on non-443 ports, exposing certificate serial numbers, issuer hashes, and nonces.

CVE-2026-118374.title: LibreSSL ocspcheck through 4.4.0 contains a memory exhaustion vul ...
CVE-2026-118374.description: LibreSSL ocspcheck through 4.4.0 contains a memory exhaustion vulnerability that allows malicious OCSP responders to exhaust memory by sending unbounded HTTP responses. Attackers controlling the responder or intercepting plain HTTP AIA OCSP traffic can stream endless headers or body data to http_head_read() and http_body_read(), denying certificate status checks.
